_about: Aesthetic policy for lib/visual.mjs, not architecture: every table here may be replaced. moodThreshold: how far (in axis units) a song's mean axes must lean along an overlay's direction before it has that mood; an overlay vector is ~.3-.5 long. moods: an overlay word (lib/overlays.json) or neutral -> the worlds it may pick from (the song's seed chooses; a song's own `visual` header key overrides). Every pool is tunnel for now: ink is chosen per song with visual: 'ink'. temperature: key mode -> a palette word. palette: visual property -> the axis whose song-wide mean it reads. voices: drum voice -> its role in any world. kinds: layer kind -> the slots it may take, in order; grain is unbounded and every list ends there. worlds: slot capacities per world.
